prompt:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot. Template: webtoon-shot-v1.
Purpose: Reveal Haeun's own name on the empty bottle and turn curiosity into personal fear.
Canvas: 1536x2048 pixels; keep a 5% safe margin.
Composition and camera: close_up shot, over_shoulder angle, portrait lens feel, camera position just behind Haeun's left shoulder at bottle-shelf height, movement push_in, focus on the empty bottle and its worn name tag, with Haeun's shocked eye still readable. empty bottle dominates the center-right; Haeun's partial face and hovering hand form a visual triangle
Subjects:
- haeun at left 0%, top 34%, width 46%, height 66%, foreground; pose left shoulder and partial profile leaning toward the shelf; expression eye widened in sudden recognition and fear; gaze fixed on the empty bottle in frame center-right; action raises her left hand but stops before touching the bottle. Preserve: chin-length navy bob, left-eye beauty mark visible, pale-blue short jacket, navy cord on raised left wrist.
Background: location school-rooftop; close section of the fixed east-wall wooden bottle shelves, rain tracking down the wall behind them. Use source crop left 52%, top 18%, width 42%, height 68%; perspective shelf lines recede gently toward frame right without warping the bottle; depth layers: Haeun's shoulder and raised hand, empty bottle with dangling tag, rows of softly blurred filled bottles and wet wall; lighting cool diffuse rain light with a small amber reflection inside the empty glass.
Visual treatment: line controlled clean webtoon linework with sharper detail on the eye, hand, glass rim, and tag; color cool restrained palette, amber tag and reflection as the only warm accent; rendering polished 2D cel shading, realistic glass edges, shallow depth of field; mood personal recognition turning into dread.
References, in authoritative input order:
- Image 1: character_identity; use only for that declared role.
- Image 2: background_space; use only for that declared role.
Continuity: screen direction left_to_right; state entering: Haeun has crossed the rooftop, umbrella remains by the door, empty bottle stays on shelf; state leaving: Haeun has recognized her name tag, her left hand hovers without touching, bottle remains unopened.
Lettering: leave visually quiet negative space in these regions: left 4%, top 4%, width 40%, height 23%. Generate no speech balloons, captions, or readable text.
Avoid: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, extra fingers, opaque bottle, legible generated tag text, changing shelf construction.
